story.title: The Pair Forest

panels.desc: Pip, Bun, Hedgie and Beads step off the last round stepping stone of the Word Pond onto the far bank and walk into a tall, quiet pine forest of huge friendly trees. A mossy path leads to a giant old tree whose trunk holds a big round wooden door with an iron ring handle; on the door are two small empty round holes side by side, close together. Two tiny identical wisps of pale light float near the holes. Pip hops in front with its beak open, listening; Bun points at the door; Hedgie peeks out from behind Bun, a little worried; Beads rides on Hedgie's flower. Grumble does NOT appear.
panels.ko: 징검다리를 건너 숲에 들어서니 커다란 나무에 둥근 문이 있어요. 문에 작은 구멍 둘, 그 옆에 똑같은 불빛 둘. "쉬… 쉬…" 소리가 나요.

panels.desc: Pim and Pam, two tiny twin bluebirds — one with a small red feather tuft, one with a small yellow feather tuft — pop out of the two round holes in the big door at the same moment, side by side with their wingtips touching, beaks open together in a cheerful hello. Pip flutters up to them, delighted; Bun waves; Hedgie's eyes go wide; Beads clicks two of its beads together. High above, among the leafy branches of the giant tree, the tip of Grumble's striped nightcap and the warm glow of his lantern peek out of a cozy treetop bed made of leaves.
panels.ko: 문 구멍에서 쌍둥이 파랑새 핌과 팜이 동시에 쏙! 둘이 함께 "안녕!" 나무 위에 그럼블의 모자와 등불이 보여요.

ask.en: What is up in the tree?

story.synopsis_ko: 징검다리를 건너 숲에 들어서니 커다란 나무에 둥근 문이 있어요. "쉬… 쉬…" 소리의 주인은 늘 붙어 다니는 쌍둥이 파랑새 핌과 팜! 나무 위에서 그럼블의 등불이 반짝여요.
story.so_far_ko: 2권에서 친구들은 글자를 합쳐 징검다리를 놓고 연못을 건너 노래 조각 둘을 찾았어요. 숲에서 똑같은 소리가 두 번 들렸어요.
story.goal_ko: 짝꿍 숲에 들어가 새 친구 핌과 팜을 만나요.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation: the friends step off the last stepping stone into the pine forest, two tiny wisps of pale light pulse twice beside the big round door in the giant tree, leaves sway, the baby bird tilts its head listening. Camera still. Calm, curious, child-friendly. No text.
